BJP MP Accuses Meta of Bias, Threatens 'Safe Harbor' Removal

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Nishikant Dubey has accused Meta of promoting anti-democratic content, claiming the platform gave 30 million views to Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) while the BJP received only 10 million views. Dubey issued an ultimatum to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, demanding an apology within three days or threatening to remove Meta's 'safe harbor' protection. This ultimatum is reportedly in response to a video concerning Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
